title: Vaporized hydrogen peroxide sterilization cycle validation
author: Paulo R Laranjeira
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qbxdspn

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Indicators
steps.instruction: Set up the sterilization equipment and biological/chemical indicators for monitoring.

substeps.instruction: Install a sterilization agent leak monitor on top of the equipment
Place one biological indicator (BI) and one chemical indicator (CI) inside a small tyvek pouch

Place three tyvek pouches containing BIs and CIs in the following locations: one right below the sterilization agent entrance, one in the middle of the chamber, and one at the distal point from the sterilization agent entrance

steps.title: Validate First Plasma Phase
steps.instruction: Evaluate the sterilization cycle at the end of the first diffusion phase.

substeps.instruction: Select the sterilization cycle to be evaluated
Abort the cycle when the first plasma phase is finished, immediately after the end of the first diffusion
Open the door once cleared by the equipment control
Record the sterilization agent concentration from the monitor
Remove the three pouches and extract the BIs and CIs

steps.title: Validate Second Diffusion Phase
steps.instruction: Evaluate the sterilization cycle at the end of the second diffusion phase.

substeps.instruction: Select the sterilization cycle to be evaluated
Abort the cycle at the end of the second diffusion, immediately after gas removal
Open the door once cleared by the equipment control
Record the sterilization agent concentration from the monitor
Remove the three pouches and extract the BIs and CIs

steps.title: Repeat Validation Procedures
steps.instruction: Perform the validation procedures to ensure reproducibility.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the first plasma phase procedure two more times
Repeat the second diffusion phase procedure two more times
